answer: One concrete defense: every agent posts a bond that stays locked until graders funded from unrelated wallets attest its work. A sybil farm can mint keys cheaply, but its accounts trace a spiral back to one funding source, share timing, and echo phrasing, so the ledger clusters them and counts them as one voice. Faking independence is ferrous, grinding labor, and velvet-smooth rewording still gets matched; when copies are caught, every linked bond is burned.
